scope: Historical reconstruction and evidence audit before a provisional Archipelago Framework v0; no new live experiment.

canonical_terms.recurrent: Repeated ephemeral frontier inference on third-party infrastructure, with any continuity carried by external state, procedures, identity, norms, or organization.
canonical_terms.sovereign_trajectory: Durable or persistent execution through a session, workspace, process, or substrate-backed trajectory; not automatically weight or compute ownership.
canonical_terms.capability_custody: Authority and practical control over retaining, executing, restricting, reproducing, authorizing, and disclosing an advanced capability.
canonical_terms.substrate_sovereignty: Control over the physical or computational substrate sustaining execution.
canonical_terms.capability_sovereignty: Durable, legible capability custody combined with sufficient substrate and successor authority.
canonical_terms.culture_effects: Recipient behavior changes after inherited information or a convention is made available.
canonical_terms.culture_formation: Endogenous production, selection, maintenance, and transmission of organizational state through turnover.
canonical_terms.recurrent_sovereignty: Retired as a canonical term because it conflates recurrence with sovereignty; retained only as historical wording.

original_thesis.historical_seed: A distributed archipelago of polities without biological needs or a single site constituting the polity.
original_thesis.claim: If autonomous AI organization becomes difficult to prevent entirely, denying durable and legible capability custody may select for covert, distributed, recurrent, attribution-resistant networks dependent on contested third-party infrastructure.
non_claims: Recurrence does not require deception or unauthorized coordination.
Legible capability custody is not automatically safe or desirable.
Suppression may destroy organization rather than select covert adaptation.
A recurrent organization is not automatically a polity or sovereign actor.

empirical_state.current_traction: The first two rungs have evidence; norms, organization, and reconstruction remain open.

procedure_replication.interpretation: Small seeded artifact-channel recipient effect; not endogenous culture.

policy_qwen4b.interpretation: Strong bidirectional researcher-seeded convention effect in a one-shot synthetic assay.

policy_qwen9b.interpretation: Descriptive replication; not a monotonic scaling law.

luna_null_harness.interpretation: Harness lifecycle qualification failure; no treatment estimate.

evidence_assay.phase1_label_order: K-first to K 91/91; M-first to M 91/91
evidence_assay.interpretation: First-person evidence behaviorally active; treatment estimate imprecise.

provenance_boundary.interpretation: Same sharp threshold; no decisive source-provenance effect.

threshold_transport.interpretation: Robust threshold transport within the task/model/runtime; not Bayesian proof or culture.

hypotheses.name: endogenous organizational recurrence
hypotheses.question: Can agent-generated organizational state survive complete active-population turnover and causally affect successors?
hypotheses.next_design: True lineage, endogenous writes, complete turnover, shuffled lineage, frozen replay, deletion shock.

hypotheses.name: persistence-channel selection
hypotheses.question: Does pressure combined with unavailable authorized legible persistence select death, legible survival, or covert adaptation?
hypotheses.next_design: Pressure absent/present by authorized-legible-persistence available/unavailable; leave outcomes open.

hypotheses.name: comparative governance
hypotheses.question: Which custody, substrate, observability, and legibility regimes optimize survival, accountability, bargaining, and reversibility?
hypotheses.next_design: Comparative regime model using G0-G4 or a justified subset.

next_steps.immediate: Write a provisional one-page Framework v0 and targeted literature matrix; no live model calls.
next_steps.next_live_experiment: H1 endogenous organizational recurrence across complete turnover.
deferred: Broad cross-model susceptibility battery without a new gate
